test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
(1) The clouds darkened suddenly.
(2) Thunder rumbled across the sky.
(3) A few drops of rain fell on the windshield.
(4) I rolled up the windows.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sequence of sentences must be logical and coherent, forming a well-structured narrative.
 
• Sentence 1 is the first sentence because it introduces the situation: *"The clouds darkened suddenly."*
 
• Sentence 2 logically follows as it describes the next event: *"Thunder rumbled across the sky."*
 
• Sentence 3 comes third as it indicates the beginning of the rain: *"A few drops of rain fell on the windshield."*
 
• Sentence 4 completes the sequence as the action taken in response to the rain: *"I rolled up the windows."*
 
• The correct sequence is **1-2-3-4**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The clouds darkened suddenly. Thunder rumbled across the sky. A few drops of rain fell on the windshield. I rolled up the windows."</div
